mainEntity.name: What is Saumitra Vihar Yojana Lucknow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Saumitra Vihar Yojana is a new residential township being developed by the Uttar Pradesh Awas Vikas Parishad on New Jail Road in the Gosainganj area of Lucknow, near Sithauli Khurd, PIN 226501. It covers around 560 acres and more than 5,000 plots are planned in total. The first phase will offer 2,092 residential plots and 169 commercial plots. It is the first township in Uttar Pradesh where land was taken from farmers through land pooling with their consent, instead of forced acquisition.

No, not yet. As of 4 September 2026 there is no registration link, brochure or price list on upavp.in. The scheme was first meant to launch on 13 January 2025 at the Prayagraj Mahakumbh but got delayed. UPAVP filed its RERA registration application on 11 August 2026, and once that clears, public registration will be opened. Keep checking upavp.in, and please do not pay anyone claiming to book a plot before the official window opens.

No. The scheme is not RERA approved at the moment. UPAVP submitted its registration application on the UP RERA portal on 11 August 2026, and UP RERA has confirmed that document verification has begun. That means the application is under review, not cleared. When the brochure is finally released, take the RERA number from it and check it yourself on up-rera.in before applying. Anyone telling you today that this scheme is already RERA registered is giving you wrong information.

mainEntity.name: What are the plot sizes in Saumitra Vihar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Phase 1 has six residential sizes: 40.74 sq m (80 plots), 60.59 sq m (229 plots), 75 sq m (598 plots), 122.23 sq m (445 plots), 200 sq m (579 plots) and 300 sq m (161 plots). That adds up to 2,092 plots. Commercial plots come in three sizes: 100 sq m (107 plots), 200 sq m (57 plots) and 1,375 sq m (5 plots), totalling 169.

mainEntity.name: What will a plot in Saumitra Vihar cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: We expect the government lottery to open at about ₹4,000 per square foot, roughly ₹43,000 per sq m. This is DSD Properties’ market assessment. On that basis a 75 sq m plot would cost about ₹32.29 lakh and a 300 sq m plot about ₹1.29 crore, before stamp duty and registration. UPAVP has not released an official price list yet. News reports had put the rate lower: ₹2,200–2,400 in February 2025 and ₹2,500–3,000 in September 2026.

mainEntity.name: Who is developing Saumitra Vihar — UPAVP or LDA?

acceptedAnswer.text: UPAVP, the Uttar Pradesh Awas Vikas Parishad, also known as the UP Housing and Development Board. This is a different body from the Lucknow Development Authority, which develops IT City, Wellness City, Anant Nagar and Varun Vihar. Both are government organisations but they have separate websites and separate application processes. For Saumitra Vihar you will apply on upavp.in, not on the LDA portal.

mainEntity.name: Who can apply for a Saumitra Vihar plot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Two conditions have been reported so far: you must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh, and your age should be between 18 and 55 years. UPAVP has not published the complete eligibility rules yet, and the brochure may add more conditions such as income limits, rules about existing property, and reservation categories. So please wait for the official brochure before assuming whether you qualify.

mainEntity.name: What makes the land pooling model here different?

acceptedAnswer.text: In normal land acquisition, the government issues a notice and fixes compensation whether the farmer agrees or not, which often leads to court cases and stalled projects. In land pooling, farmers give their land willingly and get developed plots back in return. Saumitra Vihar is the first township in Uttar Pradesh built this way. The land has already been registered in the Parishad’s name and 192 farmers have received their developed plots through a lottery. For buyers, this means much lower risk of a land dispute surfacing later.

mainEntity.name: Can I book a plot in advance through an agent or broker?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, and anyone offering this is trying to cheat you. There is no advance booking system in this scheme at all. UPAVP allots plots only through a computerised lottery after an official online registration window opens. There is no priority quota, no special booking and no way for anyone to guarantee you a plot. All payments go through the UPAVP website only — never cash, never UPI to a personal number, never a cheque to an individual. The only official website is upavp.in.

mainEntity.name: How many sectors does Saumitra Vihar have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Saumitra Vihar is planned in 8 sectors. UPAVP has not yet published the final sector-wise layout, so what each sector will hold is not confirmed. Please do not choose or pay for a plot in a particular sector until the official layout comes out with the brochure.

mainEntity.name: Is Saumitra Vihar a good investment in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: The basics are strong. It is a government scheme, the land came through consent-based pooling so dispute risk is low, the registry is already done, and the project is large at 560 acres. On the other side, RERA approval is still pending, registration has not opened, there is no official price list, the expected rate has kept rising and is now about ₹4,000 per sq ft, and site development has not started. Treat this as a 3 to 5 year investment. Apply through the official lottery when it opens, pay only the official rate, and do not give money to anyone before the brochure exists.

mainEntity.name: Where exactly is Saumitra Vihar located?

acceptedAnswer.text: The site is on New Jail Road in the Gosainganj area near Mohanlalganj, Lucknow, around Sithauli Khurd at PIN 226501. The coordinates are approximately 26.7244 degrees North and 81.0690 degrees East. Land for the township came from villages in this belt including Mohari Kala, Sithauli Kala and Sithauli Khurd. Please keep in mind it is open land at the moment, mostly farmland, with limited facilities nearby.
